video_caption: The video segment features a blonde woman with shoulder-length hair, identified by a lower third as "PATRICIA SALBER, MD, MBA - FOUNDER & HOST OF THE DOCTOR WEIGHS IN," speaking into a black microphone. She is wearing a black blazer and a silver necklace, and her expression is animated and engaged as she talks, often using hand gestures to emphasize her points. Standing to her right is a man with short brown hair, identified as "MICHAEL COHEN - PRESIDENT, MICHAEL H COHEN LAW GROUP," dressed in a dark suit jacket over a light purple collared shirt. He listens attentively to the woman, occasionally nodding or smiling. In the background, there is a cluster of red and white balloons, suggesting a celebratory or event atmosphere. Behind the man, a wall with what appears to be a framed display is visible, while behind the woman, a hallway with blurred figures walking past hints at a larger gathering. The camera remains static, focusing on the two individuals throughout their conversation.
